## Behavior and requirements

State the concrete problem, resulting behavior, affected CT requirement IDs,
module owner and linked Issue/epic. Name scope exclusions only when needed for
review.

## Verification and evidence

List actual commands/results and the tested revision. Distinguish local checks,
hosted CI, PostgreSQL integration, semantic evaluation and human observations.

## Review and gate

Describe material contract, architecture, security or migration decisions.
Include known limitations, remaining risks, acceptance evidence and the
requested sign-off. Do not advance past an unapproved phase gate.
